    def load_submission_template(path: Optional[str]=None) -> str:
        """Return the submission report template's contents.

        Reads the Markdown template from ``path`` (defaulting to the legacy
        template path). If the resolved path does not exist or cannot be read,
        the built-in default template -- which still contains all nine required
        section headers in order -- is returned instead.
        """
        resolved = LEGACY_TEMPLATE_PATH if path is None else path
        try:
            with open(resolved, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
                return handle.read()
        except OSError:
            return DEFAULT_TEMPLATE

(2) render_template — dual-mode merge (reproduce VERBATIM):

    def render_template(template: str, context: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
        """Fill placeholders in ``template`` from ``context``.

        Supports BOTH committed placeholder styles:

        * ``{{token}}`` (template-loader contract): each placeholder is replaced
          with ``str(context[token])``; missing keys, ``None`` and blank values
          render as :data:`NOT_PROVIDED_MARKER`; context keys not referenced by
          any placeholder are ignored (never appended to the output).
        * ``{token}`` (builder contract): rendered via :meth:`str.format_map`
          over a safe mapping; empty or ``None`` values collapse to
          :data:`PLACEHOLDER`.  Substituted values are inserted verbatim (they
          are not re-parsed for braces).
        """
        mapping = context or {}
        if _PLACEHOLDER_RE.search(template):

            def _substitute(match: 're.Match[str]') -> str:
                field_name = match.group(1)
                value = mapping.get(field_name)
                if value is None:
                    return NOT_PROVIDED_MARKER
                text = value if isinstance(value, str) else str(value)
                if text.strip() == '':
                    return NOT_PROVIDED_MARKER
                return text
            return _PLACEHOLDER_RE.sub(_substitute, template)
        safe = _SafeContext()
        for field_name, value in mapping.items():
            if value is None or value == '':
                safe[field_name] = PLACEHOLDER
            else:
                safe[field_name] = value
        return template.format_map(safe)

"""Tests for the submission report template loader and field renderer."""
from __future__ import annotations
import os
from ngv2 import submission_package as sp
REQUIRED_HEADERS = ['Title', 'CWE', 'Severity', 'Vulnerable Code References', 'Attack Scenario', 'PoC Reference', 'Live-Test Evidence', 'Impact', 'Suggested Fix']
ALL_FIELD_NAMES = [name for _, name in sp.SECTION_LAYOUT]

def _full_field_set() -> dict:
    return {name: 'value-for-' + name for name in ALL_FIELD_NAMES}

def test_load_template_reads_legacy_path_when_present(tmp_path):
    contents = '# Custom Template\n{{title}}\n'
    template_file = tmp_path / 'submission_report_template.md'
    template_file.write_text(contents, encoding='utf-8')
    result = sp.load_submission_template(str(template_file))
    assert result == contents

def test_load_template_falls_back_to_default_when_missing(tmp_path):
    missing = tmp_path / 'does_not_exist.md'
    assert not missing.exists()
    result = sp.load_submission_template(str(missing))
    assert result == sp.DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
    for header in REQUIRED_HEADERS:
        assert header in result

def test_default_template_contains_all_nine_section_headers():
    template = sp.DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
    indices = []
    for header in REQUIRED_HEADERS:
        marker = '## ' + header
        assert marker in template
        indices.append(template.index(marker))
    assert indices == sorted(indices), 'headers must appear in required order'
    assert len(REQUIRED_HEADERS) == 9

def test_render_template_substitutes_named_placeholders():
    template = 'Name: {{title}} / Class: {{cwe}}'
    fields = {'title': 'Path Traversal', 'cwe': 'CWE-22'}
    result = sp.render_template(template, fields)
    assert result == 'Name: Path Traversal / Class: CWE-22'
    assert '{{' not in result

def test_render_template_marks_missing_fields():
    template = 'T: {{title}} S: {{severity}}'
    fields = {'title': 'Only title'}
    result = sp.render_template(template, fields)
    assert 'Only title' in result
    assert sp.NOT_PROVIDED_MARKER in result
    empty_result = sp.render_template('{{impact}}', {'impact': '   '})
    assert empty_result == sp.NOT_PROVIDED_MARKER

def test_loaded_template_renders_cleanly_with_full_field_set(tmp_path):
    template = sp.load_submission_template(str(tmp_path / 'missing.md'))
    rendered = sp.render_template(template, _full_field_set())
    assert '{{' not in rendered and '}}' not in rendered
    assert sp.NOT_PROVIDED_MARKER not in rendered
    for name in ALL_FIELD_NAMES:
        assert 'value-for-' + name in rendered

def test_render_template_never_leaves_unsubstituted_placeholder_for_known_fields():
    template = sp.DEFAULT_TEMPLATE
    field_sets = [_full_field_set(), {name: str(i) for i, name in enumerate(ALL_FIELD_NAMES)}, {ALL_FIELD_NAMES[0]: 'x'}, {}]
    for fields in field_sets:
        rendered = sp.render_template(template, fields)
        assert '{{' not in rendered
        assert '}}' not in rendered

def test_extra_fields_are_ignored_not_appended():
    template = 'Only: {{title}}'
    fields = {'title': 'Kept', 'unreferenced_field': 'should-not-appear', 'another_extra': 'also-ignored'}
    result = sp.render_template(template, fields)
    assert result == 'Only: Kept'
    assert 'should-not-appear' not in result
    assert 'also-ignored' not in result
import pytest
from ngv2.submission_package import DEFAULT_SUBMISSION_TEMPLATE
from ngv2.submission_package import PLACEHOLDER
from ngv2.submission_package import SECTION_HEADERS
from ngv2.submission_package import build_submission_package

def make_finding():
    return {'title': 'SQL Injection in user lookup', 'cwe': 'CWE-89', 'severity': 'High', 'code_refs': ['app/db.py:42', 'app/views.py:10'], 'attack_scenario': 'Attacker submits a crafted id parameter.', 'impact': 'Full read access to the users table.', 'fix': 'Use parameterized queries.'}

def make_poc():
    return {'script': 'poc/sqli.py', 'command': 'python poc/sqli.py --target http://localhost:8000', 'expected_output': 'rows: 1\nadmin:hash'}

def make_live_report():
    return {'status': 'confirmed', 'observed': 'Database error leaked column names.', 'output': 'HTTP 500\npsycopg2.errors.SyntaxError'}

def test_returns_markdown_string_with_all_nine_sections():
    out = build_submission_package(make_finding(), make_poc(), make_live_report())
    assert isinstance(out, str)
    for header in SECTION_HEADERS:
        assert header in out
    assert len(SECTION_HEADERS) == 9

def test_title_cwe_severity_from_finding():
    finding = make_finding()
    out = build_submission_package(finding, {}, {})
    assert finding['title'] in out
    assert 'CWE-89' in out
    assert 'High' in out

def test_vuln_refs_and_attack_scenario_from_finding():
    finding = make_finding()
    out = build_submission_package(finding, {}, {})
    assert 'app/db.py:42' in out
    assert 'app/views.py:10' in out
    assert finding['attack_scenario'] in out
    single = dict(finding, code_refs='app/single.py:7')
    out_single = build_submission_package(single, {}, {})
    assert 'app/single.py:7' in out_single

def test_poc_reference_from_poc_dict():
    poc = make_poc()
    out = build_submission_package(make_finding(), poc, {})
    assert poc['script'] in out
    assert 'python poc/sqli.py --target' in out
    assert 'admin:hash' in out
    assert '```' in out

def test_live_test_evidence_from_live_report_dict():
    live_report = make_live_report()
    out = build_submission_package(make_finding(), {}, live_report)
    assert 'confirmed' in out
    assert 'leaked column names' in out
    assert 'psycopg2.errors.SyntaxError' in out

def test_impact_and_fix_from_finding_and_section_ordering():
    finding = make_finding()
    out = build_submission_package(finding, make_poc(), make_live_report())
    assert finding['impact'] in out
    assert finding['fix'] in out
    positions = [out.index(header) for header in SECTION_HEADERS]
    assert positions == sorted(positions)

def test_build_package_with_loaded_legacy_template_end_to_end():
    legacy_template = '# Submission\n\n## Title\n{title}\n\n## CWE\n{cwe}\n\n## Severity\n{severity}\n\n## Vulnerable Code References\n{code_refs}\n\n## Attack Scenario\n{attack_scenario}\n\n## PoC Reference\n{poc_reference}\n\n## Live-Test Evidence\n{live_test_evidence}\n\n## Impact\n{impact}\n\n## Suggested Fix\n{suggested_fix}\n'
    out = build_submission_package(make_finding(), make_poc(), make_live_report(), template=legacy_template)
    assert out.startswith('# Submission')
    for header in SECTION_HEADERS:
        assert header in out
    assert 'Use parameterized queries.' in out

def test_build_package_with_fallback_default_template():
    out = build_submission_package(make_finding(), make_poc(), make_live_report())
    for header in SECTION_HEADERS:
        assert f'## {header}' in DEFAULT_SUBMISSION_TEMPLATE
        assert f'## {header}' in out

def test_all_nine_headers_present_for_any_nonempty_inputs():
    variants = [(make_finding(), make_poc(), make_live_report()), ({'title': 'X', 'cwe': 79, 'severity': {'score': 9.8, 'vector': 'AV:N'}}, {'command': 'echo hi'}, {'status': 'ok'}), ({'title': 'Y', 'code_refs': 'only/one.py:1'}, {'script': 'p.py'}, {'output': 'line1\nline2'})]
    for finding, poc, live_report in variants:
        out = build_submission_package(finding, poc, live_report)
        for header in SECTION_HEADERS:
            assert header in out

def test_missing_keys_degrade_to_placeholder_without_raising():
    out = build_submission_package({}, {}, {})
    for header in SECTION_HEADERS:
        assert header in out
    assert PLACEHOLDER in out
    out_none = build_submission_package(None, None, None)
    assert PLACEHOLDER in out_none

def test_severity_accepts_dict_or_label():
    as_dict = dict(make_finding(), severity={'score': 9.8, 'vector': 'AV:N/AC:L'})
    out_dict = build_submission_package(as_dict, {}, {})
    assert '9.8' in out_dict
    assert 'AV:N/AC:L' in out_dict
    as_label = dict(make_finding(), severity='Critical')
    out_label = build_submission_package(as_label, {}, {})
    assert 'Critical' in out_label
if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, '-q']))

def _sections(package: str) -> dict:
    """Split rendered Markdown into {section header: body} (## headings)."""
    sections = {}
    current = None
    for line in package.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("## "):
            current = line[3:].strip()
            sections[current] = []
        elif current is not None:
            sections[current].append(line)
    return {k: "\n".join(v) for k, v in sections.items()}

    package = build_submission_package(FINDING, POC, LIVE)
    indices = []
    for header in NINE_SECTIONS:
        needle = "## " + header
        assert needle in package, f"missing section header: {header}"
        indices.append(package.index(needle))
    assert indices == sorted(indices), "sections out of canonical order"


def test_exactly_nine_canonical_sections_parsed():
    package = build_submission_package(FINDING, POC, LIVE)
    parsed = _sections(package)
    for header in NINE_SECTIONS:
        assert header in parsed
